body: Burnaby Bylaw 14851: Inter-Municipal Business Licence Bylaw 2026

minutes_briefs.title: Burnaby joins inter-municipal business licence program under new Bylaw 14851
minutes_briefs.summary: Burnaby has adopted Bylaw 14851, the Inter-Municipal Business Licence Bylaw 2026. This bylaw lets a business that already holds a valid business licence in one participating municipality buy a single inter-municipal licence (one extra licence that covers the other participating cities) instead of getting a separate licence in each city. The bylaw sets out how that licence works in Burnaby, including how to apply and what it covers. The article does not list which other cities are taking part or the exact start date.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Check with Burnaby's licensing office whether your business qualifies for an inter-municipal licence and how to apply.
